subtitle: Reading your standing before you ever get limited

caption: remaining = headroom left; reset = when it refills; retry-after on a 429.

eyebrow: Use the real wait time, and ease off early
code:
if resp.status_code == 429:
    wait = int(resp.headers.get("retry-after", 2 ** attempt))
    time.sleep(wait)

remaining = int(resp.headers.get(
    "anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining", 999))
if remaining < 5:
    time.sleep(1)
caption: Proactive throttling: slow down before you're forced to.
